doc.title: Doc Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 28, 1995

title: Closing: having a good time and thanks
summary: Doc says he enjoys playing with Wynton Marsalis and Jon Faddis, and the interviewers close.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: One thing is I’m having a good time.
I think that’s half of it.
Yeah I’m having a good time. I’m playing. I don’t care who I play with. I’ll play with Wynton, Wynton likes me so much.
Yeah, I saw you on T.V. with him.
He likes my playing so much. And Jon Faddis too. They all treat me so good, wonderful.

Well on that upbeat note, Hamilton College would like to thank Doc Cheatham very much for joining us for our jazz archive for a fascinating hour, and when they talk about “living legends” it’s sometimes an overused term, but I think we can use it here.
